content.title: Actual native entry, Mu and edge bodies, and node-query memo laws checked
content.text:

All five final public gates PASS: strict six modules, nine independent probes, 96,857 aggregate dependencies and 258 explicit reports (255 standard, three axiom-free). All 6,016 prior non-Audit Lean sources remain byte-exact. Pinned Nix, 8 GiB/high, zero swap, one Lean thread; only standard axioms.

Actual Mu completion now extracts its literal entered child, smaller trace and optional continuation. A closed only-U child gives the SAME result and full endpoint without binder/heap effects. Actual edge bodies and selected Mu bodies preserve BOTH existing Returned laws at EVERY supplied fuel under actual smaller-child IHs. Partial/error/blocked endpoints remain. Optional construction includes pending without a closed-child premise. Its body IH retains the SAME request, parent, emitted continuation and strict original budget; physical/readiness/key-safety inputs remain. This is memo preservation, not all recursive result laws or whole initialized history.

The actual checked enter receipt derives full operand availability and common-endpoint growth, preserving full records and heights. Genuine original-U mixed reference control excludes repeated in both orders and derives the actual binding read/reverse swap with real memo traffic. Original source/build/full pattern/domain/continuation remain; no only-U assumption is added to P.

DESIGN ONLY: a fixed ACTUALLY OBSERVED final heap may keep Returned law fixed from empty initialization and avoid growing-witness backfill. Actual suffixes derive common-reader growth; closed identity excludes taller fake patterns. Later availability cannot move backward, and one native-call initial scope does not cover old producers from earlier calls. Full native A/M induction and warm history remain open.

Source audit, no new theorem: fragment equations + UF alone do not entail removed proper paths. Actual parked clear leaves its owner pending; a structural leaf choice can violate [1]. This does not refute native membership, joint completion, or accepted-source behavior. clear_satisfies still needs post Satisfies AND all removed Holds under the SAME assignment. The missing relation must follow actual path/continuation targets.

Main target remains ONE finite accepted completion of the SAME emitted original root under ONE assignment satisfying all actual domains, paths, aliases, residuals, readback, backward recompletion and every removed obligation on THAT branch; original fuels/budgets/noStop/all outcomes/earlier emissions after later stop. Whole source/resource induction, full typing/completeness, both preprocessing/LPO directions, stream/size/count/weight/training/rank/host contracts and compiled Haskell correspondence remain. No Haskell change, bug or fix is claimed. Raw failures/headers/repairs/logs remain; terminal objects are removed after public replacements pass. Compact lossless checkpoint follows; goal ACTIVE.
